sources.title: Budgets overview and setup
sources.finding: Budget details relate planned, actual and committed spend; category rows provide context. Adapt business controls into a personal category budget.

sources.title: Ramp mobile app
sources.finding: Transaction details keep receipts, memos and category fields together. Ramp has no native desktop app; the Ledger desktop concept is an original extension.

sources.title: Ramp Budgets product page
sources.finding: Feature pages explain the budget workflow with contextual product examples and a closing action.

sources.title: Expense management
sources.finding: Receipt capture and recurring spend are concrete feature stories. Use those tasks for secondary pages, preserving Ledger styling.

sources.title: Personalized workout plans
sources.finding: Weekly plans use training days, preferred duration and activity; sessions can be swapped or reordered. FORM uses a visible weekly schedule.

sources.title: Peloton classes
sources.finding: Class discovery exposes modality, equipment, duration and instructor. Use library and individual class-detail pages.

sources.title: Peloton instructors
sources.finding: Instructor discovery connects portraits and disciplines. Extend the existing fictional Maya Chen identity for a coach profile.

sources.title: Views, filters, sorts and groups
sources.finding: Task data can be shown as lists or calendars; wide layouts can use side peek, while smaller screens use full-page detail.

sources.title: Getting started with projects and tasks
sources.finding: Projects connect task properties, notes and deadlines. Use project detail, task detail and a date-based week view.

sources.title: Personal planner templates
sources.finding: A template directory includes search, category filters, previews and individual detail pages.

sources.title: Simple Weekly Planner template
sources.finding: Template detail gives a large preview, included sections and a clear use action; create original Daybook content.

limitations: Public official guides and publisher images; no signed-in product sessions.
